mapper.select: SELECT source_id FROM behavior_event_source WHERE singleton
SELECT id,user_id,item_id FROM user_behavior WHERE action='CLICK' AND exposure_id=#{exposureId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.id,s.source_id, CASE WHEN octet_length(behavior_source_snapshot(b))<=65536 THEN behavior_source_snapshot(b) ELSE NULL END AS snapshot, to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS captured_at FROM user_behavior b CROSS JOIN behavior_event_source s WHERE b.id=#{id} AND s.singleton FOR UPDATE OF b
SELECT event_id,status FROM behavior_event_outbox WHERE behavior_id=#{id} AND source_id=(SELECT source_id FROM behavior_event_source WHERE singleton)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_event_outbox(event_id,source_id,behavior_id,origin,destination,partition_key, source_snapshot_json,source_snapshot_sha256,wire_payload_json,wire_payload_sha256,capture_reason,created_at,status,last_error) SELECT s.source_id::text||':user_behavior:'||b.id::text,s.source_id,b.id,#{origin},#{destination},#{key}, behavior_source_snapshot(b),encode(sha256(convert_to(behavior_source_snapshot(b),'UTF8')),'hex'), #{payload},encode(sha256(convert_to(#{payload},'UTF8')),'hex'),#{reason},CAST(#{capturedAt} AS timestamptz), CASE WHEN #{payload}::text IS NULL THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'READY' END, CASE WHEN #{payload}::text IS NULL THEN 'INVALID_SOURCE' ELSE NULL END FROM user_behavior b CROSS JOIN behavior_event_source s WHERE b.id=#{id} AND s.singleton
mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM behavior_event_schema_history WHERE version=#{version}
SELECT FROM behavior_event_outbox WHERE status='READY' AND available_at IS NOT NULL AND last_error IS NULL LIMIT 0

WITH due AS (SELECT event_id FROM behavior_event_outbox WHERE destination=#{destination} AND status IN ('READY','SENDING') AND available_at <= clock_timestamp() AND attempts < #{maxAttempts} ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE behavior_event_outbox o SET status='SENDING',attempts=attempts+1,fence=fence+1, available_at=clock_timestamp()+(#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second') FROM due WHERE o.event_id=due.event_id RETURNING o.event_id,o.event_type,o.schema_version, o.destination,o.partition_key,CASE WHEN octet_length(o.wire_payload_json)<=32768 THEN o.wire_payload_json ELSE NULL END AS wire_payload_json,o.wire_payload_sha256,o.fence,o.attempts
mapper.update: UPDATE behavior_event_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=clock_timestamp(),last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND fence=#{fence} AND status='SENDING' AND available_at > clock_timestamp()

WITH due AS (SELECT event_id FROM behavior_event_outbox WHERE destination=#{destination} AND status IN ('READY','SENDING') AND available_at <= clock_timestamp() AND attempts=#{maxAttempts} ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE behavior_event_outbox o SET status='DEAD',last_error='ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED' FROM due WHERE o.event_id=due.event_id
mapper.select: SELECT status,fence,attempts,last_error FROM behavior_event_outbox WHERE event_id=#{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_event_replay(replay_id,event_id,actor,reason,old_attempts,previous_fence,new_fence) VALUES(#{replayId},#{eventId},#{actor},#{reason},#{attempts},#{fence},#{fence}+1) ON CONFLICT(replay_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE behavior_event_outbox SET status='READY',attempts=0,fence=fence+1,available_at=clock_timestamp(),last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND fence=#{fence} AND status='DEAD' AND last_error<>'INVALID_SOURCE'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('READY','SENDING')) AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='DEAD') AS dead, coalesce(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('READY','SENDING'))),0) AS oldest_seconds FROM behavior_event_outbox WHERE destination=#{destination} AND status <> 'PUBLISHED'
